node: Precision substrates and components for 800G/1.6T AI optical transceivers
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the U.S.-listed universe around scarce precision substrates, compound-semiconductor components, optical-driver components, and manufacturing equipment tied to 800G/1.6T AI optical transceivers. The strongest underfollowed lead is AXTI, where official company releases directly link indium phosphide substrate demand and capacity expansion to AI infrastructure and data-center connectivity. VECO is an adjacent equipment chokepoint for scaling InP laser production. MTSI is a large-cap but unusually direct component supplier through 448G PAM4 modulator drivers that support TFLN, EML, and silicon-photonics optical platforms. LITE is included as a high-attention reference anchor for EML lasers and AI optical components, not as the primary underfollowed target.
